questions.q: What conflict does the summary say pushes physics toward new theories?
a: General relativity and quantum mechanics disagree
Thermodynamics and Newtonian gravity contradict
Loop theory and string theory use different math
Cosmology and biology describe different scales
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the two pillars contradict each other, which opens room for new ideas.

questions.q: What does loop quantum gravity say about space?
a: Space is built from tiny loops rather than being smooth
Space is an empty container that never changes
Space curves only near black holes
Space stretches faster than the speed of light
questions.why: Lesson 1 describes space as made of microscopic loops.

questions.q: What is heat, according to the summary?
a: Friction that makes atoms vibrate faster
A fluid called caloric that flows between objects
Energy released when atoms split apart
Light absorbed by the surface of objects
questions.why: Lesson 2 explains heat as atomic motion caused by friction.

questions.q: How does the summary connect heat with the passage of time?
a: Friction drains energy, giving time a direction
Time is a fluid that flows through space
Gravity alone creates the past and future
Hotter rooms make clocks run faster
questions.why: Lesson 2 links friction and heat loss to the arrow from past to future.

questions.q: What does the summary say about people and the universe?
a: We are made of the same atoms as stars and belong to it
We observe the universe from outside its laws
Physics cannot explain any human behavior
Human curiosity stands apart from nature
questions.why: Lesson 3 says our bodies share the atoms of stars and we are participants, not outsiders.
